queries.query: Does Article 11(6) of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 support this requirement: Test the ICT business continuity plans and response and recovery plans at least once a year; also test them following a major change to a critical or important function

Which provision of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 is materially necessary for this requirement but absent from the existing mapping: Test the ICT business continuity plans and response and recovery plans at least once a year; also test them following a major change to a critical or important function

item.control_statement: Test the ICT business continuity plans and response and recovery plans at least once a year; also test them following a major change to a critical or important function
